QUOTE: "The user taps the failed post, which opens a bottom sheet (`app/components/post_list/post/body/failed/index.tsx`). \"Try Again\" calls `retryFailedPost(serverUrl, post)`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that retry occurs only via the user choosing "Try Again" on the failed post (no automatic retries, each tap is one attempt) and names `retryFailedPost`.
